Synthetic red/blue raster fixtures; no photos or device captures.

Build: xcrun clang++ -std=c++17 generate.cpp -lcups -o /tmp/liuying-raster-fixture
Generate: /tmp/liuying-raster-fixture urf one-page.urf
Use pwg for PWG; landscape and two-pages in the output name select those cases.

synthetic.heic: generated red/green/blue/yellow quadrants, 96x64, for Windows Web import tests; no user photos.
